summary.text: Dean Cray is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 69 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A farmer, he previously served in the Maine House from 2008 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Dean Cray lives in Palmyra, Maine, and his career experience includes working as a farmer, a school bus driver, and a transportation director.
He first served in the Maine House of Representatives for District 28 from 2008 to 2014, and during that time sat on the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.
He returned to the House in December 2022, succeeding Walter Riseman, and in 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.
